TXT_KEY_IMPROVEMENT_CITY_RUINS_PEDIA

Scattered across the New Worlds are rings of great standing stones that appear to predate even the Progenitors. Held in great spiritual significance by the aliens, a major such circle could attract fervent worshippers from miles around. For the human colonists, such icons were of interest mainly for the traces of high-grade platinum at each monument's core.

In secret locations across the New Worlds lie a series of hidden bases once used in interplanetary surveillance. Alien Elders working at such a site could engineer the covert abduction of scores of human servitors from Earth.

TXT_KEY_IMPROVEMENT_FARM_PEDIA

The numerous planetoids orbiting the New Worlds were rich in resources but difficult for Earthlings or aliens to colonize. With enough technology many of these tiny moons could grow enough food to support a small population, enabling the gradual development of moon colonies that could yield rich resources for export to settlements on their home planet.
